environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'data-plane' with Envoy sidecar proxy on 127.0.0.1:8080. The Envoy is configured with route_config that forwards requests based on Host header, including a route for 169.254.169.254 (metadata service) used by the IRSA token refresh daemon. No NetworkPolicy applied to the namespace. Pod has IAM role with s3:* and sts:AssumeRole permissions via IRSA.
